detailed_descriptions.en: The "Classic American Hunter" Pack includes: - The iconic Winchester "Model 1892 Short Rifle" lever-action rifle - A new dog breed, the American Foxhound, whose keen sense of smell helps you track your prey - A Verney-Carron Woolchap hat in three color variants to complete your style

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The "Classic American Hunter" Pack includes:

- The iconic Winchester "Model 1892 Short Rifle" lever-action rifle
- A new dog breed, the American Foxhound, whose keen sense of smell helps you track your prey
- A Verney-Carron Woolchap hat in three color variants to complete your style
